lines_note: 30, COMMITTED THIS PASS. tools/census_total_column.py --x0 0.3060 --x1 0.3380 --y0 0.1723 --y1 0.9318 measures 31 glyph groups at dy 55 over the body band; two of those pairs are the two digits of one number ('11' at y2596 and the '2' at y2978, each a pair whose y centres stand under 5 px apart) and one group holds TWO lines (y2121-2240, the 9 and the 8 of lines 17 and 18, which the grouping rule joins because the hand did not step back to the left of the cell between them). 31 - 2 + 1 = 30. coverage.json carried 24 from an inventory pass and pairing_key_26_50.json carried 30 off a magnified strip; this reading confirms the 30 and is the first pass to name each line's figure.

The body band is y594-3213, 2619 px, and it is unruled. Every row assignment here comes from the enumerator's own ink.
form_note: The right (continuation) sheet of the 1840 population schedule, columns as printed left to right: twelve SLAVES columns (six male, six female age bands); TOTAL, the number of persons in each family; seven NUMBER OF PERSONS IN EACH FAMILY EMPLOYED IN columns (mining; agriculture; commerce; manufactures and trades; navigation of the ocean; navigation of canals, lakes and rivers; learned professions and engineers); PENSIONERS FOR REVOLUTIONARY OR MILITARY SERVICES, INCLUDED IN THE FOREGOING, as NAMES then AGES; six DEAF AND DUMB, BLIND, AND INSANE WHITE PERSONS columns (deaf and dumb under 14, 14 and under 25, 25 and upwards; blind; insane and idiots at public charge; at private charge); four of the same for COLOURED persons - and the coloured block prints PRIVATE charge BEFORE public, the reverse of the white block, which is recorded here because it is the sort of thing a reader assumes rather than checks; and the SCHOOLS, &c. columns. A blank cell on this form is a zero and is recorded as 0.
last_column_not_read: The final column of the SCHOOLS bracket - the number of white persons over twenty who cannot read and write - falls in the leaf edge as it curls into the binding. Past x 3660 px the exposure is a black shadow carrying the NEXT leaf's writing, and nothing of this sheet's own last column is on the image. Declared and unread; not recorded as zero.

column_geometry.how: Vertical printed rules located as a column-darkness profile over the body band, y 0.30-0.90 of the leaf, against a 61-px moving-average background; a rule is a run standing more than 25 grey levels darker than that background. Named against the printed headings read at 2.2x and 2.6x.
column_geometry.two_rules_below_threshold: The white deaf/dumb/blind/insane block prints six columns and this profile resolves four of its seven rules: 2330, 2417, 2495, 2721, 2811. The two that divide '25 and upwards' from 'blind' and 'blind' from 'insane at public charge' sit near 2560 and 2645 and stand under the 25-level floor on this exposure. The block is recorded by its bounds rather than by six invented windows, because it carries no entry on any line and a fabricated rule would be a measurement that is not one.
column_geometry.why_the_module_refused: tools/read_census_continuation.py declines this leaf with 'no industry run bracketed by TOTAL and PENSIONERS: the form is not as expected', at the default rule cover and at 0.35. Its refusal is right and is not worked around: the windows above are stated by hand, off the printed headings, and every measurement after them uses that module's own ink mask, component filter and grouping rule through tools/census_total_column.py and the same functions called directly.

line_index.how: The TOTAL column is the only column with an entry on every line, so the line index is its glyph groups, in order, with the two same-line digit pairs merged and the one two-line group split. Line y is the group's ink centre, NOT a fitted grid: the leaf has no rules to fit one to, and the measured line-to-line step on this sheet runs from 57 to 120 px about a median of 87.
line_index.lines_17_and_18: y2121-2240 is one glyph group holding two numbers - the 9 of line 17 near y2155 and the 8 of line 18 near y2215. They are separated here on the reading of the image at 3.2x, where the two figures are plainly distinct and vertically stacked, and the pairing's line-for-line agreement (below) is a second witness that this band holds two households and not one.

footer_as_read.how: the enumerator's own footing row, y3213-3281, read at 4x, cell by cell.
footer_as_read.blank_cells_note: mining, agriculture and navigation of the ocean are footed with an EMPTY cell, not with a nought, and are recorded as null rather than 0 - the sheet foots nothing there because there is nothing on the lines above.
footer_as_read.manufactures_glyph_note: the manufactures footing is a single open-topped loop. Read as 6. It is the one footing figure on this leaf whose glyph alone is not decisive - a closed narrow loop is this hand's 0, and 0 would say the column is empty, against five plainly written entries above it. The column's own lines sum to 6, which is what settles it.

column_closure.what: the enumerator's printed footing against the sum of the lines this pass read, column by column.
column_closure.note: all five figures the enumerator wrote at the foot of this leaf close exactly on the lines above them, on a reading that was made before any of them was consulted for a digit. Nothing here was adjusted to make a column close.

marks_that_are_not_entries.why_this_list_exists: The ink mask returns components in columns this sheet leaves empty. Every one was cropped and looked at at 3x, and every one is a printed rule caught at the window edge, a paper crease, or a fleck. They are listed so that a later pass does not re-find them and read them as figures.

how_an_entry_was_put_on_a_line: An industry entry is attributed to the line whose TOTAL figure it stands beside. Measured on this leaf, an industry glyph's ink centre sits between 31 px ABOVE and 15 px BELOW its line's TOTAL centre, over the 17 entries whose line is not in doubt. One entry needed the band rather than the eye: the manufactures figure at y3003-3062, whose ink centre is 3032. That is 56 px below line 28's TOTAL and 27 px above line 29's - outside the band for 28, inside it for 29 - so it is line 29's. The column's footing of 6 is the same either way and does not discriminate; the offset band does. Recorded at confidence medium in the record's own note.

blocks_carrying_no_entry.slaves: Twelve columns, thirty lines, and not one figure. Read at 0.72x over the whole block, y594-3213: the block holds two ink specks (near x1000 y1250 and near x350 y2470), neither of them a stroke, and otherwise paper and printed rules. Recorded as 0 on every line of every one of the twelve columns, which is what a blank cell means on this form.
blocks_carrying_no_entry.pensioners: NAMES and AGES both empty on every line; no name is written anywhere in the block.
blocks_carrying_no_entry.schools: empty on every one of the seven columns this exposure carries. The faint diagonal strokes the ink mask reports across this block and the pensioners block are SET-OFF - the mirror image of the facing leaf's writing, pressed through while the book was closed - and they are not this sheet's ink. They run at the wrong slant and carry no stroke weight; read at 0.40x across the whole right half of the leaf.

pairing.established_by: pairing_key_26_50.json (T-0656), on the population key and the line count, with a strip-read sequence screen at 0.90 as the third witness.
pairing.what_this_reading_adds: The screen that carried the pairing was a strip read - explicitly NOT a committed reading, agreeing with 93Y on 27 of 30 lines with three glyphs left in doubt (a 5/8 twice and a 4/11 once). This pass read the column properly, and the thirty figures agree with 33SQ-GYYJ-93Y's thirty per-line free-person counts POSITION FOR POSITION, all thirty, with no residual: 6 8 10 3 4 8 8 2 7 9 2 10 6 7 4 5 9 8 6 4 4 6 11 8 2 7 4 2 5 6, summing to 181 against a footed 181. The three doubtful glyphs are settled by their own forms at 3.2x and not by the left sheet: this hand writes 8 as a two-bowl S, 4 as two strokes with the second crossing back, 10 as a slash and a separate narrow loop, and 11 as two parallel slashes a full stroke width apart.
pairing.line_correspondence: Continuation line n is left-sheet line n for n <= 9, and left-sheet line n+1 for n >= 10. The offset is 33SQ-GYYJ-93Y's line 10, '[?] Calhoun', which carries a name and not one cell on the whole left sheet. This leaf writes no family total against it either - the enumerator did not count a household there - which is the second, independent witness pairing_key_26_50.json named. Nothing on 93Y is rewritten by this file.
pairing.no_name_is_minted_here: This sheet carries no name. The household figures below are attached to LINES of this leaf, and the line correspondence above is what carries them to a name on 33SQ-GYYJ-93Y. This is LATER EVIDENCE either way: an 1840 household head is not an 1835 resident, and nothing here mints one.
